name: The Missing Diplomat
label: Quest
description: The Missing Diplomat: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Let me be first to thank you for all you've done, friend. You have been an incredible blessing to my people and the people of Stormwind. I am sorry I couldn't make your acquaintance under better circumstances.
Understand also that I cannot overtly thank you for your efforts, but I assure you again, it is appreciated.
When you visit Theramore in the future, seek me out and I shall try to keep you apprised of the situation.
